title: Meta begins ~8,000 layoffs in AI restructuring
summary: Meta began cutting about 8,000 jobs while reassigning ~7,000 staff to AI teams, as part of an AI-focused restructuring.
reason: Mass layoffs explicitly tied to AI push. Notices reported May 19-21; mid date used. [Editor: marked as development of an earlier-scored event to avoid double counting.]

title: Leaked audio: Meta tracked employee activity to train AI
summary: Leaked all-hands audio showed Zuckerberg defending a 'Model Capability Initiative' that logged employees' Gmail, coding and tool activity for AI training; employees protested.
reason: Workplace surveillance feeding AI training plus internal backlash; single company.

title: OpenAI model disproves Erdos unit-distance conjecture, checked by outside mathematicians
summary: An internal OpenAI reasoning model produced a proof disproving Erdos's 1946 conjectured bound for the planar unit distance problem; external mathematicians including Tim Gowers and Noga Alon reviewed it and wrote a companion paper.
reason: Rubric T3 example: independently verified AI solution to a long-open math problem; general-purpose model working autonomously. Skeptic pass keeps T3 (external verification).

title: CNBC: Anthropic posts first profitable quarter
summary: CNBC reported Anthropic turned profitable for the first time in Q2 2026 with ~$10.9B projected quarterly revenue, driven by enterprise and coding demand.
reason: Revenue concentration in a few frontier labs; financial milestone.

title: Jack Clark puts 60%+ odds on recursive self-improvement by 2028
summary: In Oxford's Cosmos Lecture, Anthropic co-founder Jack Clark predicted AI-run firms within 18 months and a 60%+ chance of recursive self-improvement by end-2028, acknowledging non-zero risk of harm.
reason: Lab leader warning (opinion/signal), capped at T1.
